macros.name: listingindent
macros.doc: The amount by which the listing text is indented is controlled by the \listingindent length parameter.

macros.name: listingsize
macros.doc: The text size used in the listing environment is set by the \listingsize command.

macros.name: settabwidth
macros.doc: The tabs used by our tabbed verbatim environments are set up by this routine. It sets the tab width parameter \svtab to 8 times the width of a \tt space.

macros.name: verbinput
macros.doc: You can input a pre-prepared text file exactly as it is in the input using the \verbinput command.

envs.name: verbwrite
envs.doc: You can write verbatim text to a file using the verbwrite environment.
